Name: Its Britney Beach
Author: aldrichosaurusrex30
Description:
[A/N] Hello! My 4th farm map! I really like the beach farm but with my playstyle, it gets a little crowded. Like usual, if you like my farm map please dont forget to endorse! I really want that Krobus pin OTL. My 2nd entry on the Stardew Modfest 2026!

Known Issues: 
~Greenhouse dirt tile when first moving it. I did put a sort of like a buffer tile underneath so it doesn't have that visual bug.
~When using VPR don't choose the Beach farm as a replacement.
~The second cave is marked as outside so itll rain, but you can put beehouse, solar panels and lightning rods. I tried making it indoors, but the lighting crashes the game every time you enter it.  Also serves as a Greenhouse. You can also cask inside!
~I never did try switching between the 2 farms so I don't know how it'll affect your game file so choose CAREFULLY!

Installation Guide:
~Like any other mod, download and unzip it BUT choose which farm to use as it has 2 Maps inside the folder. For comparison, check the mod pictures. When done, put the desired farm type on your mods folder. I did try to make it as one then you just use the GMCM to choose which farm you want but for the life of me can't seem to make it work.

~You can catch ocean fish in here.
~2 caves so you can use a modded one.
~Spawns forage and crates.
~Up to 6 multiplayer or you can just ask robin to build you extra cabins.
~Standard map is the default farm to replace. When making a new save, choose on the mod menu on which farm to replace.
~And yes, its SDVE compatible. Just go to the SDVE mod menu and change the nexus warp to X=101, Y=48
~Sprinkler friendly!
